subtitle: Medicare coverage decision support
shortDescription: Local-first Medicare decision support with printable report packets.
longDescription: Coverage Compass helps users turn a Medicare coverage-structure assessment into premium printable conversation guides, verification checklists, and decision-defense packets. It is educational decision support, not plan sales, insurance enrollment, brokerage, or legal, financial, or medical advice.
reviewNotes: Current private-beta scope is local-first educational decision support. The app does not sell insurance, enroll users in plans, or connect to Medicare.gov accounts. Printable packets are saved or printed through the browser's native print flow.
launchBlockers: Final legal entity and support contact
